# CCD.SCHOOL

> Learn music production and DJing with structured, gamified missions. A Cats Can Dance project, built in Bengaluru.

CCD.SCHOOL teaches through short missions with interactive sound simulators (all audio is synthesised in the browser) and quizzes. Progress is tracked with XP, streaks and spaced-repetition review.

## Worlds
- Fundamentals: 40 missions on sound, rhythm, melody, harmony and music technology.
- DJ World: 40 missions on setup, library, mixing, performance and mastery, based on the rekordbox manual.
- Producer: 73 missions on Ableton Live 12, sound design, MIDI, mixing, performance and synthesis.

## Pages
- /worlds: choose a world
- /missions: all 153 missions
- /glossary: music production and DJ terms
- /devices: Ableton device explainers
- /signal-flow: how audio moves through a mixer and a DAW
- /placement: placement test to find your starting point
- /leaderboard: weekly XP leaderboard

## Access
The first three missions of every path are free. The rest need a Pro plan.

## Part of Cats Can Dance
Cats Can Dance is a Bengaluru music and pet-culture brand: https://catscandance.com
